//: Redeclaration is safe: monfactions::load_monster_faction uses get_or_add_faction, so this merges with the Civilians mod's identical faction when both are loaded, and stands alone when it is not.
name: civilians

//: Hostility must be DECLARED.  resolve_attitude_map walks up base_faction and, finding no relation, returns MFA_FRIENDLY (src/monfaction.cpp:149-152) - the default is friendly, not hostile.  Omitting player made bikers passive toward the player while still fighting zombies, which were explicitly hated.
name: cv_bandit

//: The store owner alone.  He is territorial rather than hostile, so the player will often end up killing him in self-defence - and while he shared the `civilians` faction that turned every other civilian in sight against them.
//2: FRIEND_ATTACKED propagates by exact faction identity, not attitude (src/monster.cpp:4222: `if( critter.faction != this->faction ) continue;`), so separating him is the only thing that actually stops it.
//3: base_faction human, exactly like `civilians` and `cv_bandit`: resolve_attitude_map walks the target's base chain (src/monfaction.cpp:136-151), so everything that hates humans still hates him without listing him.
//4: player MUST stay friendly.  attitude() returns MATT_FRIEND below anger 10 and only reaches MATT_ATTACK above it - that threshold IS the territorial behaviour.
name: cv_shopkeeper
